dailyStudyTime.question: On average, how much time can you prepare each day?
dailyStudyTime.supporting: We will adjust your daily training load to the time you select.

fifteen_minutes.title: 15 minutes
fifteen_minutes.description: Complete one essential task without feeling overwhelmed.

thirty_minutes.title: 30 minutes
thirty_minutes.description: Train two essential capabilities in balance.

sixty_minutes.title: 1 hour
sixty_minutes.description: Combine interview practice with application preparation.

ninety_plus_minutes.title: 1 hour 30 minutes or more
ninety_plus_minutes.description: Prepare systematically with focused practice, feedback, and review.

im1.prompt: Introduce yourself through the strength and experience that best represent you.

im2.prompt: Why do you want to become cabin crew?

im3.prompt: What strength distinguishes you from other applicants?

im4.prompt: Why did you choose this airline?

im5.prompt: What value would you like to provide as cabin crew?

im6.prompt: What kind of cabin crew member would you like to become?

be1.prompt: Tell us about a time you noticed and resolved a customer's discomfort.

be2.prompt: How did you resolve a disagreement with a team member?

be3.prompt: Tell us about a mistake or failure and how you improved afterward.

be4.prompt: Tell us about meeting your responsibility under significant pressure.

be5.prompt: Tell us about adapting quickly to a new environment.

be6.prompt: Tell us about a positive result created through your actions.

cs1.prompt: How would you respond to a passenger strongly demanding a seat change?

cs2.prompt: How would you respond to an argument between passengers?

cs3.prompt: How would you guide a passenger complaining about a delay?

cs4.prompt: How would you explain a rule to a passenger who refuses to follow it?

cs5.prompt: How would you help a passenger when you do not share a language?

cs6.prompt: How would you calm a dissatisfied customer while maintaining policy?

sj1.prompt: What would you prioritize when safety and service conflict?

sj2.prompt: What would you do if a colleague missed part of a safety procedure?

sj3.prompt: How would you respond if a passenger tried to move during turbulence?

sj4.prompt: What would you do if an exit-row passenger did not follow instructions?

sj5.prompt: In what order would you act when a passenger needs medical help?

sj6.prompt: When should you report a difficult judgment to a supervisor?
